title: deparia oldhamii
intro: Deparia oldhamii, commonly known as Oldham's chain fern or Oldham's wood fern, is a species of fern in the family Woodsiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Deparia oldhamii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
